name: Lazybrief
description: Overnight do-it-later inbox: a local Gemma (via Ollama) sorts the day's links, notes and todos into a five-line morning brief. No keys, no per-token cost, nothing leaves the machine.
author: NurstarK

skills.description: Run the overnight Lazybrief sort on a local Gemma (Ollama) and deliver the five-line brief through ./notify. Needs a self-hosted runner or local run — the model lives on localhost:11434.
